article.title: Trump Is Tearing It Apart
article.author: Ted Vaill
article.content: The opinions expressed here are solely the author's and do not reflect the opinions or beliefs of the LA Progressive. For the past almost 70 years, I have been involved in politics, starting in 1957 when as a high school student I published in a national environmental magazine an article that called the U.S. national parks “America’s Wilderness Slums”. To his credit, President Eisenhower fixed this problem, which, of course, Trump is bringing back.As we reach the 2026 Midterms, I have the following random thoughts: We have to make sure that we never again have a President as morally corrupt and evil as Donald Trump. How do we do this? The Republican Party (I used to be a member) has to be destroyed or neutered so much by the voters that it changes its ways and returns to be the party it was in the 1960s (before Watergate) when I was the Legislative Assistant to a ranking Republican Congressman. We were the “loyal Opposition” to the Democratic majority. Today’s Republicans are often greedy, cruel pseudo-“patriots” who really are more like British loyalists than patriots like my ancestor Lt. Pelatiah Everett, who served under George Washington from 1775-1783. Where is the evidence that Trump is actually “winning” the Iran war? Almost all our “news” of the Iran war comes from military sources that may be doctored to show great successes like General Westmoreland did with the daily “body counts” he sent out from Vietnam (a war in which I served as a Navy JAG lawyer who opposed the war). By the way, I first opposed the Vietnam war in October, 1965, when the ranking Republican on the House Foreign Affairs Committee I worked for asked me to do a white paper on the pros and cons of the Vietnam War. I found 20 reasons why it was a bad idea and five why it was a good idea (two of which were later proved to be lies). Since then, I have always trusted my political judgment. That is why I believe that Trump must be and will be removed from office before he destroys our democracy. Related: Trump Denied Project 2025: Now He’s Carrying It Out By the time you read this, you should know if there is a “blue wave” returning the House and Senate to true opposition to the destruction of America that Trump has promulgated since January 20, 2025 with the help of the so-called Heritage Foundation. If the American voters decide that what Trump has done over the past 22 months is wonderful, it will cause a lot of us Democrats to leave the country or go underground to throw out Trump and his thugs. If there is a blue wave or even a blue tsunami, then America is on its way back to being a true democracy with the interests of its citizens, rich and poor, well and disabled, educated and less educated, addressed every day in Congress. I keep thinking of the brilliant Hans Christian Andersen’s story about “The Emperor Who Had No Clothes”. Donald Trump has shown that he has been walking around without wearing any clothes all his life, from the day in 1946 when he was born with a golden spoon in his mouth. And he grew up as a rich, racist bully who later used the teachings of his friend and advisor Roy Cohn to admit no wrong, deny everything, and to always hit below the belt. My ancestors have been fighting to create and preserve this country for the past 406 years, since my ancestor Gov. William Bradford landed at Plymouth on the Mayflower in 1620. My past 10 generations of Vaills and Everetts worked hard to make America what it is now, from fighting in the Revolutionary War, to being leaders of their Connecticut communities as ministers, to helping establish what is now a top college (Amherst), to inventing the the folding chair, to helping patent the radio tube and inventing the telegraph, to helping develop the Norden bombsight that destroyed Germany and ended World War lI. We are seven generations of college graduates, going back to Rev. Joseph Vaill, Dartmouth Class of 1778. Related: Trump’s Reichstag Fire And then there were the Drumpfs, who fled to America from Germany to escape the Kaiser’s military service and got rich from the brothels he ran in Seattle and the Klondike, to Donald’s father, conceived in Germany, who got rich building tenements in Brooklyn and Queens, gouged his poor tenants, at the same time as he attended KKK rallies and raised his son Donnie to care only for himself. And Donnie, how dare you spend your life stiffing your suppliers, cheating on your wives, and operating like a Mafia boss? You have no heart , and are a selfish son of a bitch. In fact, your mother was one of the immigrants (from Scotland) that you love to denigrate.7 . All of us know someone who is so self satisfied with their lives that they do not have an ounce of care for anyone outside their immediate family. All they care about is the stock market and how rich they and their family can get. They love to drive around in their Teslas. And they are proud to be Trumpsters. May they burn in hell…
